grammar_topic: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

ex1_mcq.title: Exercise 1: Multiple Choice Questions
ex1_mcq.instruction: Choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) that correctly applies verbs with prepositions or relative clauses referring to a whole sentence.
ex1_mcq.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.text: The environmental committee decided to dispose ______ all obsolete electronic devices through an authorized recycling center.
questions.explanation: Động từ 'dispose' đi với giới từ 'of' (dispose of sth: vứt bỏ, xử lý rác thải đúng quy chuẩn).

questions.text: More suburban commuters have switched to public transport, ______ has contributed significantly to reducing air pollution in the city center.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ mệnh đề phía trước bắt buộc dùng ', which' (không dùng 'that', 'this' hay 'what').

questions.text: Our biology teacher urged all students to participate ______ the weekend campaign to clean up plastic litter along the riverbank.
questions.explanation: 'participate' đi với giới từ 'in' (participate in sth: tham gia vào hoạt động gì).

questions.text: The eco-club replaced disposable plastic cups with a reusable cup and glass jar, ______ helps minimize single-use packaging waste.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' đứng sau dấu phẩy thay thế cho cả sự việc thay thế cốc nhựa ở vế trước.

questions.text: Environmentalists warn that rising global temperatures directly result ______ the burning of fossil fuels and heavy greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation: 'result from sth' mang nghĩa 'bắt nguồn từ, do cái gì gây ra' (nguyên nhân đứng sau 'from').

questions.text: Excessive accumulation of organic matter in landfills results ______ the production of hazardous methane and carbon dioxide.
questions.explanation: 'result in sth' mang nghĩa 'dẫn đến kết quả gì' (kết quả đứng sau 'in').

questions.text: The local youth organization succeeded ______ encouraging households to sort waste into each proper recycling bin.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'succeed in doing sth' (thành công trong việc làm gì).

questions.text: The industrial plant manager apologised ______ discharging untreated chemical pollutants into the municipal canal.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'apologise for doing sth' (xin lỗi vì đã làm điều gì).

questions.text: Many conscious teenagers truly care ______ adopting a sustainable zero waste lifestyle to protect natural resources.
questions.explanation: 'care about sth' mang nghĩa 'quan tâm, coi trọng điều gì'.

questions.text: All residents in the green village rely ______ clean green energy generated from community solar panels and wind turbines.
questions.explanation: 'rely on sth' mang nghĩa 'trông cậy, dựa vào nguồn gì'.

questions.text: Before dropping a takeaway container into the recycling bin, you should rinse ______ any oily leftovers to prevent contamination.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ 'rinse out' có nghĩa là súc sạch, rửa sạch chất bẩn/thức ăn thừa bên trong hộp.

questions.text: The school cafeteria stopped providing single-use containers, ______ was warmly appreciated by eco-friendly students.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ sự việc ở mệnh đề trước phải dùng ', which'.

questions.text: Stricter regulations are required to protect marine wildlife ______ consuming toxic plastic debris drifting in the ocean.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'protect sb/sth from doing sth' (bảo vệ ai/cái gì khỏi nguy cơ gì).

questions.text: My family created a backyard compost pile, ______ allows us to turn each fruit peel and vegetable leftover into rich organic fertilizer.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc lập hố ủ phân ở mệnh đề trước.

questions.text: The park rangers took urgent precautions to prevent the devastating wildfire ______ spreading toward endangered animal habitats.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'prevent sth from doing sth' (ngăn chặn cái gì khỏi...).

questions.text: Installing a modern sensor tap and an automatic light across school buildings saves electricity and water, ______ is essential for green living.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' thay thế cho toàn bộ nội dung của mệnh đề phía trước.

questions.text: Sustainable farming models refuse to depend ______ artificial chemical fertiliser that depletes soil fertility.
questions.explanation: 'depend on sth' (phụ thuộc vào cái gì).

questions.text: Instead of buying bottled water, Minh carries a reusable bottle and refills it daily, ______ saves him considerable money in the long run.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' thay thế cho hành động mang bình nước và rót đầy nước mỗi ngày.

questions.text: The conservation committee strongly approved ______ the youth proposal to convert each cardboard box into a bird feeder and plant pot.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'approve of sth' mang nghĩa 'tán thành, ủng hộ việc gì'.

questions.text: Metropolitan cities are struggling to cope ______ hundreds of tons of solid household waste transported to landfills every day.
questions.explanation: 'cope with sth' nghĩa là 'đối phó, xoay xở xử lý vấn đề khó khăn gì'.

ex2_verbform.title: Exercise 2: Verb Form & Conjugation
ex2_verbform.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
ex2_verbform.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.text: The eco-friendly supermarket focuses on (reduce) ______ single-use plastic packaging by offering biodegradable cloth tote bags.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'on' trong cụm 'focus on', động từ theo sau chia ở dạng danh động từ (V-ing).

questions.text: The youth volunteer club succeeded in (clean) ______ up three tons of plastic litter along the polluted river canal.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'succeed in doing sth': sau giới từ 'in' động từ có dạng danh động từ 'cleaning'.

questions.text: Our school installed an automatic light in every corridor, which (save) ______ a tremendous amount of electrical energy each month.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc ở mệnh đề trước (coi là chủ ngữ số ít), động từ chia thì hiện tại đơn ngôi thứ ba số ít ('saves').

questions.text: Instead of throwing away plastic takeaway containers, we should (reuse) ______ every container as a plant pot.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu 'should', động từ giữ nguyên thể không 'to' ('reuse').

questions.text: The chemical plant manager apologised to local residents for (fail) ______ to prevent industrial pollutants from leaking into the reservoir.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'apologise for doing sth': sau giới từ 'for' động từ chia ở dạng danh động từ ('failing').

questions.text: Many suburban families depend on (compost) ______ household waste to produce rich natural fertiliser for their vegetable patches.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'on' trong cụm 'depend on', động từ chia V-ing ('composting').

questions.text: The community planted five hundred shade trees in the public square, which (provide) ______ fresh air and shade for neighborhood children.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' đại diện cho toàn bộ sự việc trồng cây, động từ chia ngôi thứ ba số ít 'provides'.

questions.text: Transitioning to green energy and public transit directly (contribute) ______ to reducing dangerous greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ là danh động từ 'Transitioning...' (ngôi thứ ba số ít), đi với 'contribute to' thì hiện tại đơn chia 'contributes'.

questions.text: Volunteers spent their entire Saturday morning (sort) ______ recyclable cardboard boxes and glass jars at the community center.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'spend time doing sth': chia V-ing ('sorting').

questions.text: Non-biodegradable plastics take centuries to (decompose) ______ in landfills, which severely damages underground soil ecosystems.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'take + time + to-V': sau 'to' dùng động từ nguyên thể ('decompose').

questions.text: The industrial company was heavily fined for (discharge) ______ untreated wastewater and chemical contaminants into the ocean.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'for' (bị phạt vì hành vi gì), động từ chia ở dạng danh động từ 'discharging'.

questions.text: Every citizen can practice green living by (turn) ______ off unnecessary electrical appliances when leaving the house.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'by' chỉ phương thức, động từ chia V-ing ('turning off').

questions.text: The cafe replaced plastic smoothie cups with a glass jar, which (help) ______ eliminate unnecessary single-use waste.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ ', which' thay cho cả sự việc thay cốc của quán cà phê, động từ chia số ít 'helps'.

questions.text: Dr. Ha dedicated her scientific career to (find) ______ biodegradable packaging materials that decompose rapidly in soil.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'dedicate sth to doing sth': 'to' là giới từ nên động từ đi sau chia V-ing ('finding').

questions.text: Properly building a compost pile prevents an organic fruit peel from (rot) ______ in landfills and releasing methane gas.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'prevent sth from doing sth': sau giới từ 'from' động từ chia V-ing ('rotting').

questions.text: Our school canteen decided to ban plastic straws, which (encourage) ______ students to bring their own reusable metal straws.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' thay cho việc nhà trường cấm ống hút nhựa, động từ chia số ít 'encourages'.

questions.text: The residential complex committed to (switch) ______ entirely to solar green energy before the beginning of the dry season.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'commit to doing sth' (cam kết làm gì): 'to' là giới từ nên động từ chia V-ing ('switching').

questions.text: Local wildlife conservationists succeeded in (protect) ______ wild animals from consuming toxic landfill litter.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ 'in' trong 'succeed in', động từ chia V-ing ('protecting').

questions.text: The municipal council opened a rapid electric bus route, which (make) ______ public transport far more appealing to urban commuters.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ sự việc mở tuyến xe buýt điện, động từ chia ngôi thứ ba số ít 'makes'.

questions.text: Before (refill) ______ your reusable water bottle at the communal filtered station, please ensure it has been thoroughly sanitized.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ/liên từ rút gọn chỉ thời gian 'Before', động từ chia ở dạng danh động từ 'refilling'.

ex3_matching.title: Exercise 3: Match the Sentence Halves
ex3_matching.instruction: Match the sentence beginnings (1–10) with the appropriate endings (A–J) to build syntactically sound and coherent sentences.
ex3_matching.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.half_a: Our residential community decided to replace every conventional street bulb with an automatic light,
Many careless households fail to rinse out greasy food residue from each takeaway container,
The youth environmental club passionately encourages students to participate
Conscious residents always separate each organic fruit peel and leftovers from household waste,
The university dining hall decided to transition entirely to clean green energy,
The city council installed a water-saving sensor tap and smart meters across all municipal offices,
Farmers across the river valley depend

options.label: A
options.half_b: which significantly reduces our municipal electricity bills and overall carbon footprint.

options.label: B
options.half_b: which contaminates an entire batch of recyclable items inside each cardboard box at the depot.

options.label: C
options.half_b: in weekend clean-up drives to prevent hazardous plastic litter from harming wild animals.

options.label: D
options.half_b: which makes it much simpler to build a balanced, odorless compost pile in the garden.

options.label: E
options.half_b: of banning single-use plastic straws and takeaway containers across all commercial stores.

options.label: F
options.half_b: which inspires neighboring enterprises to adopt sustainable green living practices.

options.label: G
options.half_b: which helps conserve scarce natural resources and prevents a severe waste of water.

options.label: H
options.half_b: on natural compost layers instead of spraying synthetic chemical fertiliser over farmland.

options.label: I
options.half_b: in converting discarded plastic containers into a charming plant pot and bird feeder.

options.label: J
options.half_b: on electric buses and public transport, which noticeably mitigates urban air pollution.

ex4_rewrite.title: Exercise 4: Sentence Transformation
ex4_rewrite.instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the cue provided so that it has the closest meaning to the original sentence.
ex4_rewrite.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.original_sentence: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom. This significantly decreased electricity consumption.
questions.correct_answer: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which significantly decreased electricity consumption.
acceptable_answers: The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which significantly decreased electricity consumption.
The school installed an automatic light in each classroom, which helped decrease electricity consumption.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc lắp đèn tự động ở mệnh đề trước.

questions.original_sentence: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers. This causes severe harm to wild animals.
questions.correct_answer: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which causes severe harm to wild animals.
acceptable_answers: People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which causes severe harm to wild animals.
People dump untreated plastic packaging into rivers, which harms wild animals.
questions.explanation: Kết hợp hai câu thành một bằng mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' để nêu hệ quả của hành vi vứt rác nhựa làm hại động vật hoang dã.

questions.original_sentence: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline. This prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
questions.correct_answer: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
acceptable_answers: The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which prevented plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
The volunteers participated in cleaning up the polluted shoreline, which helped prevent plastic litter from drifting into the open ocean.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay cho toàn bộ nỗ lực dọn rác bờ biển của nhóm tình nguyện viên.

questions.original_sentence: Excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels leads to high greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.correct_answer: High greenhouse gas emissions result from excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
acceptable_answers: High greenhouse gas emissions result from excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
High greenhouse gas emissions result from the excessive burning of coal and fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Chuyển từ 'lead to' (dẫn đến) sang 'result from' (bắt nguồn từ / do nguyên nhân gì gây ra).

questions.original_sentence: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill causes catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
questions.cue: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results
questions.correct_answer: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results in catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
acceptable_answers: Dumping unsorted household waste into a landfill results in catastrophic soil and groundwater pollution.
questions.explanation: Sử dụng cấu trúc 'result in sth' (gây ra, dẫn đến kết quả gì).

questions.original_sentence: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school. This habit helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
questions.cue: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school,
questions.correct_answer: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
acceptable_answers: Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps her reduce single-use plastic waste.
Lan always carries a reusable bottle, a reusable cup, and a metal straw to school, which helps reduce single-use plastic waste.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ ', which' thay cho thói quen mang bình nước, cốc dùng nhiều lần và ống hút kim loại đi học.

questions.original_sentence: The farming cooperative relies on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
questions.correct_answer: The farming cooperative depends on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
acceptable_answers: The farming cooperative depends on organic compost instead of applying synthetic chemical fertiliser.
questions.explanation: Thay thế động từ 'relies on' bằng 'depends on' (dựa vào / phụ thuộc vào).

questions.original_sentence: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps. This practice provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
questions.correct_answer: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps, which provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
acceptable_answers: The eco-hotel began composting leftover kitchen scraps, which provides rich nutrient layers for organic gardens.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ việc ủ thức ăn thừa của khách sạn sinh thái.

questions.original_sentence: You should not throw away a glass jar because you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
questions.correct_answer: Instead of throwing away a glass jar, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
acceptable_answers: Instead of throwing away a glass jar, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
Instead of throwing a glass jar away, you can easily reuse it as a charming plant pot.
questions.explanation: Sau cụm giới từ 'Instead of' dùng danh động từ V-ing ('throwing away').

questions.original_sentence: Many urban residents do not care about how much electricity they waste each month.
questions.cue: Many urban residents pay no attention to
questions.correct_answer: Many urban residents pay no attention to how much electricity they waste each month.
acceptable_answers: Many urban residents pay no attention to how much electricity they waste each month.
Many urban residents pay no attention to their waste of electricity each month.
questions.explanation: Cụm 'pay no attention to' (không để ý đến) đồng nghĩa với 'do not care about'.

ex5_guided_cloze.title: Exercise 5: Guided Cloze Passages
ex5_guided_cloze.instruction: Read the passages below and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each numbered blank.
ex5_guided_cloze.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

passages.title: The Road to Sustainable Zero Waste Living
passages.content: In recent decades, rapid urbanization and consumerism have generated vast amounts of municipal (1) ______ that overwhelm local landfills. Discarded plastic takes centuries to (2) ______ naturally underground, releasing hazardous chemicals into soil. Furthermore, excess takeaway (3) ______ and single-use containers frequently clutter streets. To counter this crisis, modern citizens actively advocate (4) ______ living by adopting sustainable habits. Before discarding recyclable items, conscious people always (5) ______ out oily food residues so the items do not become (6) ______ during recycling. They diligently (7) ______ waste into designated receptacles, placing paper into the (8) ______ bin and food into a compost pit. Instead of throwing kitchen leftovers into a general rubbish (9) ______, families build an odorless (10) ______ pile in their gardens. They layer dry brown leaves with a moist (11) ______ peel, (12) ______ produces dark, rich humus for home gardens. This natural method eliminates any need to depend (13) ______ toxic chemical fertiliser that harms beneficial earthworms. In public buildings, administrators now install a modern (14) ______ tap and automatic lighting, (15) ______ prevents a senseless waste of electricity and water. Commuters are also encouraged to rely (16) ______ public transport rather than personal vehicles, (17) ______ helps combat dense city air pollution. Many eco-conscious workers bring a reusable (18) ______ to office coffee bars and carry a reusable water bottle, (19) ______ significantly curbs disposable cup pollution. All these practical steps demonstrate that communities genuinely (20) ______ about preserving our planet.

questions.explanation: 'municipal waste' nghĩa là rác thải đô thị / rác thải sinh hoạt.
'decompose' mang nghĩa phân hủy tự nhiên trong lòng đất.
'takeaway packaging' là bao bì đóng gói đồ ăn mang về.
'green living' là lối sống xanh, bảo vệ môi trường.
Cụm động từ 'rinse out' nghĩa là súc sạch, rửa sạch chất bẩn bám dính.
'contaminated' có nghĩa là bị vấy bẩn, nhiễm tạp chất.
'sort waste' nghĩa là phân loại rác thải tại nguồn.
'recycling bin' là thùng rác tái chế chuyên dụng.
'rubbish bin' là thùng rác sinh hoạt thông thường.
'compost pile' là đống / hố ủ phân vi sinh hữu cơ.
'fruit peel' là vỏ hoa quả thừa sau khi ăn.
Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc ủ lá khô và vỏ quả ở mệnh đề trước.
Cấu trúc 'depend on sth' (phụ thuộc vào cái gì).
'sensor tap' là vòi nước cảm ứng tự ngắt tiết kiệm nước.
Dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ hành động lắp vòi cảm ứng và đèn tự động.
Cấu trúc 'rely on sth' (dựa vào, trông cậy vào phương tiện gì).
Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc đi lại bằng xe buýt công cộng.
'reusable cup' là cốc uống nước có thể dùng lại nhiều lần.
Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho hành vi mang cốc và bình nước cá nhân.
'care about sth' mang nghĩa quan tâm sâu sắc đến việc bảo vệ môi trường.

passages.title: Protecting Our Ecosystem from Environmental Degradation
passages.content: Global environmental degradation has become one of the most critical challenges of our era. Massive deposits of untreated rubbish trapped in each open (21) ______ decompose anaerobically, (22) ______ in the emission of potent greenhouse gases like (23) ______ and carbon dioxide. These toxic gases trap atmospheric heat, (24) ______ accelerates catastrophic global climate (25) ______. Unchecked global warming intensifies prolonged droughts and severe (26) ______ that burn thousands of hectares of ancient forests every summer. When forests burn, hazardous smoke and dangerous (27) ______ particles fill the atmosphere, causing chronic respiratory illnesses among residents. Furthermore, carelessly discarded plastic items and takeaway (28) ______ clutter rivers and coastlines, where they (29) ______ wild animals that mistakenly ingest them. To cope (30) ______ these pressing issues, communities worldwide are taking bold action. Grassroots groups organize weekly drives to clean (31) ______ public beaches and urban canals. Volunteers succeed (32) ______ collecting tons of plastic waste and repurposing discarded materials into an attractive (33) ______ pot or a bird feeder. Progressive enterprises have also pledged to invest (34) ______ renewable green energy like wind and solar power. In everyday life, families separate garbage into organic scraps and recyclable cardboard (35) ______. They place dry organic waste in balanced (36) ______ inside garden compost pits instead of relying on toxic chemical fertilisers. Many schools also teach students to turn (37) ______ unnecessary electrical lights, which avoids a senseless (38) ______ of electricity. Adopting an eco-friendly mindset helps every family shrink its carbon footprint. Although changing established consumer habits requires persistent effort, the collective benefits are immense in the long (39) ______. We must all participate (40) ______ saving our fragile planet before irreversible ecological damage occurs.

questions.explanation: 'open landfill' là bãi rác lộ thiên.
'resulting in sth' là mệnh đề phân từ mang nghĩa 'dẫn đến kết quả là'.
'methane' là khí mê-tan, một loại khí nhà kính gây hại.
Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho việc giữ nhiệt khí quyển ở mệnh đề trước.
'climate change' là cụm từ chỉ biến đổi khí hậu toàn cầu.
'wildfires' là các vụ cháy rừng dữ dội trong mùa khô hạn.
'pollutant particles' là các hạt bụi mịn chất ô nhiễm.
'takeaway containers' là các hộp đựng đồ ăn mang đi bằng nhựa.
'harm wild animals' nghĩa là làm hại, gây nguy hiểm cho động vật hoang dã.
'cope with sth' nghĩa là đương đầu, giải quyết khó khăn thử thách.
Cụm động từ 'clean up' nghĩa là thu dọn sạch sẽ rác thải.
Cấu trúc 'succeed in doing sth' (thành công trong việc làm gì).
'plant pot' là chậu trồng cây.
Cấu trúc 'invest in sth' (đầu tư vào nguồn năng lượng nào).
'cardboard boxes' là thùng giấy / hộp các-tông có thể tái chế.
'layers' là các lớp (rải từng lớp rác hữu cơ khi ủ phân vi sinh).
Cụm động từ 'turn off' nghĩa là tắt các thiết bị điện khi không dùng.
'waste of electricity' là sự lãng phí điện năng.
Cụm thành ngữ 'in the long run' mang nghĩa về lâu về dài.
Cấu trúc 'participate in sth' (tham gia vào việc bảo vệ hành tinh).

ex6_error_identification.title: Exercise 6: Error Identification & Correction
ex6_error_identification.instruction: Identify the bracketed part (A, B, C, or D) that contains a grammatical error, then provide the correct form.
ex6_error_identification.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.text: The local community [A: decided to] install solar panels, [B: that] significantly [C: reduced] their monthly [D: reliance on] fossil fuels.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ mệnh đề phía trước sau dấu phẩy bắt buộc dùng 'which', không được dùng 'that'.

questions.text: The active youth volunteers [A: succeeded on] [B: sorting] household waste into each [C: recycling bin] across the [D: neighborhood].
questions.explanation: Động từ 'succeed' kết hợp với giới từ 'in' (succeed in doing sth), không đi với 'on'.

questions.text: Many students genuinely [A: care about] green living, [B: which] [C: motivate] them to eliminate every [D: single-use] container.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ sự việc ở mệnh đề trước được tính là chủ ngữ số ít, do đó động từ chia thì hiện tại đơn phải thêm 's' ('motivates').

questions.text: The cafeteria manager [A: apologised to] all students [B: to using] polystyrene [C: takeaway container] units instead of a sturdy [D: cardboard box].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc chuẩn là 'apologise (to sb) for doing sth' (xin lỗi ai vì đã làm gì), không dùng 'to using'.

questions.text: Non-biodegradable packaging takes centuries to [A: decompose] in landfills, [B: this] releases dangerous [C: greenhouse gases] and [D: contaminates] groundwater.
questions.explanation: Hai mệnh đề nối với nhau sau dấu phẩy mà vế sau chỉ hệ quả của cả câu trước phải dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which', không dùng đại từ chỉ định 'this'.

questions.text: The manufacturing plant was [A: fined for] disposing [B: with] toxic chemical pollutants [C: directly into] the municipal water [D: canal].
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ chính xác là 'dispose of sth' (xử lý / thải bỏ rác hoặc chất độc), không dùng 'dispose with'.

questions.text: Urban citizens must [A: learn to] cope [B: about] unpredictable climate change, [C: which] intensifies summer droughts and [D: catastrophic wildfires].
questions.explanation: 'cope' đi với giới từ 'with' (cope with sth: đối phó, thích nghi với khó khăn), không dùng 'cope about'.

questions.text: The university [A: fitted] a water-efficient sensor tap in each restroom, [B: which] [C: prevent] a tremendous [D: waste of] clean water.
questions.explanation: Đại từ ', which' đại diện cho toàn bộ sự việc lắp vòi cảm ứng ở mệnh đề trước nên động từ chia ngôi thứ ba số ít ('prevents').

questions.text: Farmers across the valley [A: rely at] organic compost piles [B: rather than] spraying synthetic [C: chemical fertiliser] over [D: agricultural crops].
questions.explanation: Động từ 'rely' đi với giới từ 'on' (rely on sth: dựa dẫm, trông cậy vào cái gì), không đi với 'at'.

questions.text: The park rangers [A: prevented] careless campers [B: for] leaving hazardous plastic [C: litter] near the riverbank [D: bird feeder].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'prevent sb/sth from doing sth' (ngăn chặn ai khỏi việc làm gì), không dùng 'for'.

ex7_sentence_combination.title: Exercise 7: Sentence Combination
ex7_sentence_combination.instruction: Combine each pair of sentences into a single, cohesive sentence using the target grammatical structure indicated.
ex7_sentence_combination.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.sentence_1: The school cafeteria decided to eliminate every single-use takeaway container.
questions.sentence_2: This prevents hundreds of kilograms of non-biodegradable waste from entering landfills.
questions.correct_answer: The school cafeteria decided to eliminate every single-use takeaway container, which prevents hundreds of kilograms of non-biodegradable waste from entering landfills.
acceptable_answers: The school cafeteria decided to eliminate every single-use takeaway container, which prevents hundreds of kilograms of non-biodegradable waste from entering landfills.
The school cafeteria decided to eliminate every single-use takeaway container, which helps prevent hundreds of kilograms of non-biodegradable waste from entering landfills.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ quyết định loại bỏ hộp đựng đồ ăn mang về dùng một lần.

questions.sentence_1: Burning agricultural leftovers generates excessive smoke and toxic carbon dioxide.
questions.sentence_2: This results in severe air pollution across neighboring residential districts.
questions.correct_answer: Burning agricultural leftovers generates excessive smoke and toxic carbon dioxide, which results in severe air pollution across neighboring residential districts.
acceptable_answers: Burning agricultural leftovers generates excessive smoke and toxic carbon dioxide, which results in severe air pollution across neighboring residential districts.
Burning agricultural leftovers results in severe air pollution across neighboring residential districts.
questions.explanation: Kết hợp câu sử dụng cấu trúc ', which results in' chỉ kết quả dẫn đến ô nhiễm không khí nặng nề.

questions.sentence_1: Suburban commuters have increasingly switched from private vehicles to electric public transport.
questions.sentence_2: This demonstrates a notable growth in civic environmental awareness.
questions.correct_answer: Suburban commuters have increasingly switched from private vehicles to electric public transport, which demonstrates a notable growth in civic environmental awareness.
acceptable_answers: Suburban commuters have increasingly switched from private vehicles to electric public transport, which demonstrates a notable growth in civic environmental awareness.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' thay thế cho hành vi chuyển sang dùng phương tiện công cộng của người dân.

questions.sentence_1: Careless tourists forgot to turn off their campfire before departing the forest.
questions.sentence_2: This caused a catastrophic wildfire that devastated hundreds of hectares of trees.
questions.correct_answer: Careless tourists forgot to turn off their campfire before departing the forest, which caused a catastrophic wildfire that devastated hundreds of hectares of trees.
acceptable_answers: Careless tourists forgot to turn off their campfire before departing the forest, which caused a catastrophic wildfire that devastated hundreds of hectares of trees.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' để nêu hệ quả đau lòng của việc quên dập tắt lửa trại.

questions.sentence_1: The conservation crew diligently cleaned up plastic debris along the coastal mangrove forest.
questions.sentence_2: This prevented toxic plastic fragments from harming wild animals in the nature reserve.
questions.correct_answer: The conservation crew diligently cleaned up plastic debris along the coastal mangrove forest, which prevented toxic plastic fragments from harming wild animals in the nature reserve.
acceptable_answers: The conservation crew diligently cleaned up plastic debris along the coastal mangrove forest, which prevented toxic plastic fragments from harming wild animals in the nature reserve.
Cleaning up plastic debris along the coastal mangrove forest prevented toxic plastic fragments from harming wild animals in the nature reserve.
questions.explanation: Kết hợp câu dùng ', which prevented... from' diễn tả việc dọn rác đã ngăn chặn mảnh nhựa làm hại động vật hoang dã.

questions.sentence_1: Local vegetable farmers stopped relying on synthetic chemical fertiliser.
questions.sentence_2: They began spreading organic compost layers over their planting beds.
questions.correct_answer: Instead of relying on synthetic chemical fertiliser, local vegetable farmers began spreading organic compost layers over their planting beds.
acceptable_answers: Instead of relying on synthetic chemical fertiliser, local vegetable farmers began spreading organic compost layers over their planting beds.
questions.explanation: Dùng 'Instead of + V-ing' (Thay vì dựa vào phân bón hóa học...).

questions.sentence_1: The municipal office installed an automatic light and a sensor tap in every department.
questions.sentence_2: This prevents an unnecessary waste of electricity and water.
questions.correct_answer: The municipal office installed an automatic light and a sensor tap in every department, which prevents an unnecessary waste of electricity and water.
acceptable_answers: The municipal office installed an automatic light and a sensor tap in every department, which prevents an unnecessary waste of electricity and water.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề ', which' thay cho toàn bộ việc lắp đặt đèn tự động và vòi cảm ứng thông minh.

questions.sentence_1: Students thoroughly rinsed out greasy food residues from each takeaway container.
questions.sentence_2: Then they placed the cleaned plastic item into the recycling bin.
questions.correct_answer: Before placing the cleaned plastic item into the recycling bin, students thoroughly rinsed out greasy food residues from each takeaway container.
acceptable_answers: Before placing the cleaned plastic item into the recycling bin, students thoroughly rinsed out greasy food residues from each takeaway container.
Students thoroughly rinsed out greasy food residues from each takeaway container before placing it into the recycling bin.
questions.explanation: Dùng liên từ chỉ thời gian 'Before + V-ing' để kết hợp trình tự hai hành động.

questions.sentence_1: The manufacturing enterprise transitioned entirely to rooftop solar green energy.
questions.sentence_2: This will significantly shrink their company's carbon footprint in the long run.
questions.correct_answer: The manufacturing enterprise transitioned entirely to rooftop solar green energy, which will significantly shrink their company's carbon footprint in the long run.
acceptable_answers: The manufacturing enterprise transitioned entirely to rooftop solar green energy, which will significantly shrink their company's carbon footprint in the long run.
questions.explanation: Dùng ', which' thay thế cho toàn bộ việc chuyển đổi sang dùng năng lượng mặt trời.

questions.sentence_1: More families in our neighborhood are adopting sustainable zero waste habits.
questions.sentence_2: This clearly indicates that citizens genuinely care about environmental protection.
questions.correct_answer: More families in our neighborhood are adopting sustainable zero waste habits, which clearly indicates that citizens genuinely care about environmental protection.
acceptable_answers: More families in our neighborhood are adopting sustainable zero waste habits, which clearly indicates that citizens genuinely care about environmental protection.
questions.explanation: Dùng đại từ quan hệ ', which' đại diện cho việc các gia đình thực hành lối sống không rác thải.

ex8_sentence_building.title: Exercise 8: Sentence Building from Cues
ex8_sentence_building.instruction: Use the given cue words to write grammatically complete and meaningful sentences using verbs with prepositions and relative clauses.
ex8_sentence_building.target_grammar: Verbs with prepositions, Relative clauses referring to a whole sentence

questions.cues: Many / eco-conscious / families / turn off / unnecessary / appliances / which / prevent / waste of electricity
questions.correct_answer: Many eco-conscious families turn off unnecessary appliances, which prevents a waste of electricity.
acceptable_answers: Many eco-conscious families turn off unnecessary appliances, which prevents a waste of electricity.
questions.explanation: Thêm mạo từ và chia động từ: 'turn off' (hiện tại đơn số nhiều) và 'prevents' (chia số ít sau ', which').

questions.cues: Households / should / rinse out / dirty / takeaway container / before / throw / it / recycling bin
questions.correct_answer: Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it into the recycling bin.
acceptable_answers: Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it into the recycling bin.
Households should rinse out a dirty takeaway container before throwing it in the recycling bin.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ 'rinse out', sau 'before' dùng danh động từ 'throwing', thêm giới từ 'into the recycling bin'.

questions.cues: The school / start / compost / each / fruit peel / garden waste / which / provide / organic fertiliser / plant pot
questions.correct_answer: The school started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
acceptable_answers: The school started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
The school has started composting each fruit peel and garden waste, which provides organic fertiliser for each plant pot.
questions.explanation: 'started composting', liên từ 'and', đại từ ', which' đi với động từ số ít 'provides', giới từ 'for each plant pot'.

questions.cues: Volunteers / succeed / clean up / plastic litter / along / canal / which / protect / wild animals / harm
questions.correct_answer: Volunteers succeeded in cleaning up plastic litter along the canal, which protected wild animals from harm.
acceptable_answers: Volunteers succeeded in cleaning up plastic litter along the canal, which protected wild animals from harm.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'succeeded in cleaning up', mạo từ 'the canal', ', which' và 'protected wild animals from harm'.

questions.cues: The company / commit / eliminate / single-use / packaging / which / contribute / sustainable / green living
questions.correct_answer: The company committed to eliminating single-use packaging, which contributes to sustainable green living.
acceptable_answers: The company committed to eliminating single-use packaging, which contributes to sustainable green living.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'committed to eliminating', đại từ ', which', động từ 'contributes to sustainable green living'.

questions.cues: Using / public transport / instead / private / cars / lower / carbon emissions / which / combat / climate change
questions.correct_answer: Using public transport instead of private cars lowers carbon emissions, which combats climate change.
acceptable_answers: Using public transport instead of private cars lowers carbon emissions, which combats climate change.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ danh động từ 'Using... lowers', cụm 'instead of', đại từ ', which' và động từ số ít 'combats climate change'.

questions.cues: The factory / apologise / dispose / toxic / chemical pollutants / local / landfill
questions.correct_answer: The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants into the local landfill.
acceptable_answers: The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants into the local landfill.
The factory apologised for disposing of toxic chemical pollutants in the local landfill.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'apologised for disposing of' và thêm mạo từ 'the local landfill'.

questions.cues: Students / craft / charming / bird feeder / discarded / cardboard box / which / impress / their / biology teacher
questions.correct_answer: Students crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box, which impressed their biology teacher.
acceptable_answers: Students crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box, which impressed their biology teacher.
questions.explanation: Chia thì quá khứ đơn 'crafted a charming bird feeder from a discarded cardboard box', mệnh đề ', which' bổ nghĩa cho cả câu.

questions.cues: Transitioning / green energy / lower / greenhouse gas emissions / which / benefit / planet / long run
questions.correct_answer: Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits our planet in the long run.
acceptable_answers: Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits our planet in the long run.
Transitioning to green energy lowers greenhouse gas emissions, which benefits the planet in the long run.
questions.explanation: 'Transitioning to green energy lowers...', đại từ ', which' đi với 'benefits our planet in the long run'.

questions.cues: Installing / sensor tap / restroom / save / clean water / which / demonstrate / high / environmental awareness
questions.correct_answer: Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves clean water, which demonstrates high environmental awareness.
acceptable_answers: Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves clean water, which demonstrates high environmental awareness.
questions.explanation: 'Installing a sensor tap in each restroom saves...', mệnh đề ', which' đi với 'demonstrates high environmental awareness'.
